questions.prompt: Which war was fought between Britain and the Boer republics?

questions.prompt: Which type of radiation is stopped by a sheet of paper?

questions.prompt: Which US state is known as the Golden State?

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle?
